tools.name: search_teaching_clips
tools.description: Finds the few minutes inside real lectures where a teacher explains a topic, for a teacher planning a class, by the topic's name and the class's Level. Typical requests it serves: "a few minutes of a lecture on the chain rule for my Grade 12 class", "a concrete example of entropy for first-year chem

tools.name: list_curricula
tools.description: The curricula with a study guide on Bettyapp: Bettyapp's general syllabus, what school courses generally teach in a subject at an age, with its guides: each guide's id, title, course, Subject, Level, grade and how many topics it has. Useful for a guide's id, and for which subjects and ages Bettyapp

tools.name: find_by_curriculum
tools.description: One study guide's topics in the course's order: each topic's unit, name, what it covers, its codes in the curriculum (section numbers), and its clips (the guide's own picks), recommended or fallback as in a topic's clip search. The guide is named by its id ("general/physics/grade-12"), or by its sub

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: One clip in full, by the clip_id a tool gave ("1234:osmosis", "1234:osmosis:2"), or a lecture's id and a second ("1234@300", the moment starting nearest it, within 90 seconds): everything a clip has in a topic's clip search, and the moment's summary, the questions it answers, its topics and the teac

tools.name: get_topic_pathway
tools.description: For a topic, the topics recommended before it (recommended_before), those that come next (next), and related topics, each with its best clip judged to teach it, or a fallback moment with its reason. The order comes from how courses teach the topics: a suggestion, not a rule, and only where courses a

tools.name: get_levels
tools.description: A topic at each Level Bettyapp has a lecture for it, from school to university: one clip a Level, the Levels as the lectures are placed. Useful for an easier or a harder explanation, or for a mixed class. A Level with no lecture is left out; Bettyapp says nothing about a Level it has no lecture at.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_teaching_clips" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
